title: Pork and Ricotta Meatballs
description: Tender, juicy meatballs made with ricotta, Parmesan, and ground pork. Perfect served on their own, with marinara, or over pasta.

steps.instruction: In a large bowl, combine all ingredients and gently mix until just combined.
Shape the mixture into 12 evenly sized meatballs.
Place meatballs on a greased baking sheet.
Bake for about 15 minutes, until golden and cooked through.
Serve warm with sauce or as desired.
